articles.title: El gran misterio de los WC: para qué sirve la abertura frontal en forma de 'U' que hay en los inodoros públicos
articles.text:
No soy muy aficionado a las apuestas, pero seguro que no me equivoco si digo que gran parte de quienes leerán este reportaje lo harán sentados en un retrete. No es solo intuición. Hay estudios que constatan que la mayoría de los españoles (84%, precisa un estudio de Renova) suele entregarse a los placeres de la lectura cuando sus posaderas tocan el váter. Si es tu caso y estás sentado en el trono, te animo a que compruebes algo: ¿Qué forma tiene el asiento? ¿Es un óvalo cerrado en forma de 'O' o más bien dibuja una 'U', con la parte frontal abierta?
Todo dependerá de dónde estés, si en el baño de tu casa o un aseo público.
El gran misterio de los WC. Hay preguntas que se pasan años y años circulando por Internet, desapareciendo y reapareciendo como el Guadiana, rodeadas de teorías disparatadas. Una de ellas es por qué hay retretes con el asiento abierto en la parte frontal. Ya sabes, esos inodoros con tapa en forma de 'U' que suelen verse sobre todo en los baños de hospitales, estaciones y centros comerciales. Incluso en aviones y trenes. ¿Por qué utilizan ese diseño? ¿Tiene alguna ventaja? Y si es así, ¿por qué no los instalamos en nuestras casas?
Si buscas en Google encontrarás un buen puñado de artículos actuales que se plantean esas preguntas, las mismas que ya se hacían los autores de blogs hace más de una década o que de tanto en tanto circulan por redes. El tema despierta tanto interés que un tuit publicado en mayo por Akash Gupta precisamente para aclarar esos misterios acabó acumulando cerca de 7,3 millones de visualizaciones, 11.000 'me gusta' y cientos y cientos de comentarios de todo tipo.
¿Qué son los WC en 'U'? Ni más ni menos que eso: inodoros que tienen una apertura frontal en el asiento abatible, con lo que dibujan una especie de 'U'. Son frecuentes sobre todo en aseos públicos y su diseño contrasta con la solución más común en las viviendas, donde las tapas de los váteres suelen tener forma de 'O' alargada. Que no encontremos el mismo modelo en los baños de las estaciones y en los hogares particulares tiene poco de misterioso. Responde a los consejos de la industria, que lleva décadas apostando por esa diferencia al instalar WC.
De hecho, es un hábito tan antiguo que puede remontarse al menos a 1955, cuando los fontaneros de EEUU publicaron el 'American Standard National Plumbing Code', un código que buscaba unificar criterios en el sector. En él leemos que lo ideal es que los asientos de los WC se fabriquen con materiales lisos no absorbentes y que aquellos destinados a edificios públicos sean además "de frente abierto". Esa misma pauta se mantuvo en otros manuales posteriores, como el Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC), publicado a principios de los 70.
Pero… ¿Por qué? La gran pregunta. Que la industria apueste por los asientos abiertos en los baños públicos no responde la cuestión clave: ¿Por qué? ¿Por qué usarlos en los aseos de aeropuertos y centros comerciales? Para Gupta hay sobre todo cuatro grandes razones. O mejor dicho, el diseño en forma de 'U' sirve para resolver de una sola tacada cuatro problemas comunes en los baños públicos.
El primer motivo es el más evidente. Los retretes públicos no suelen ser los lugares más limpios del mundo, de ahí que habitualmente intentemos reducir al máximo el contacto físico cuando los usamos. Al eliminar la sección frontal de los asientos de los inodoros se reduce la superficie de interacción y, por lo tanto, la posibilidad de tocar gérmenes con la piel. "Menos centímetros cuadrados compartidos, menos puntos de transferencia bacteriana", concluye.
That gap has been legally required in every U.S. public restroom since 1955. It solves four problems simultaneously.
The official name is the "open-front toilet seat." The American Standard National Plumbing Code mandated it seven decades ago. California's state plumbing code… https://t.co/kDztvsCR2E
Menos contacto, más higiene. El segundo motivo por el que se utilizan asientos en forma de 'U' está muy relacionado con el anterior: la apertura frontal permite a las mujeres limpiarse sin que su mano toque la superficie de plástico. Sin esa sección la mano puede pasar con mayor facilidad, evitando el contacto con un plástico en el que antes se han sentado decenas cientos de personas. 
No solo eso. Al prescindir de la parte frontal se elimina un espacio en el que podría acumularse orina de otras personas. "El siguiente usuario se sienta en plástico seco, no el error de otros", ironiza Grupta, quien añade otra razón extra (algo más extravagante) por el que los edificios públicos apuestan por los diseños en forma de 'U': reduce las tentaciones de los amigos de lo ajeno. Al no coincidir con los modelos domésticos, tiene menos incentivos para arrancarlos.
¿Son las únicas explicaciones? No. Hay quien desliza otras, como que las tapas con apertura frontal facilitan el trabajo de los enfermeros y cuidadores que tienen que acompañar a personas con movilidad reducida al baño. De ahí que se instalen en las habitaciones de los hospitales. A la hora de limpiarlos, la ausencia de la sección delantera facilita también el trabajo y reduce la humedad.
Las cosas son distintas en los hogares, donde los WC son usados por muchas menos personas (habitualmente miembros de una misma familia) y ya no es una prioridad reducir el contacto con el asiento. Eso explica que en las viviendas se opte por modelos cerrados, quizás menos higiénicos pero más cómodos.

articles.title: Spotify y Netflix lideran la lista de marcas más usadas en estafas en América Latina
articles.text:
Las plataformas de streaming y los servicios digitales, como Spotify y Netflix, se han convertido en los principales blancos de las campañas de phishing y estafas en América Latina, según el último Informe de Amenazas Financieras de Kaspersky.
El uso intensivo de estas marcas en la vida cotidiana de millones de usuarios de la región ha facilitado que los ciberdelincuentes adapten sus engaños para pasar desapercibidos y obtener datos sensibles.
PUBLICIDAD
La relevancia de este fenómeno radica en que los ataques ya no se enfocan solo en bancos o tiendas online, sino que explotan la confianza y la familiaridad que generan las plataformas de entretenimiento, comercio electrónico y sistemas de pago recurrentes.
Phishing: el nuevo rostro de las estafas digitales
El phishing, una de las técnicas más utilizadas por los ciberdelincuentes, ha evolucionado y hoy recurre a marcas populares para hacer que los engaños sean más convincentes. En América Latina, Spotify encabeza la lista de marcas suplantadas en campañas de phishing relacionadas con compras y servicios digitales.
PUBLICIDAD
A nivel mundial, Netflix es la marca más utilizada en fraudes vinculados a compras online (28%), seguida de Apple (21%), Spotify (18%), Amazon (18%) y Shopify (4%).
El Top 10 global también incluye gigantes como Alibaba Group, eBay, Taobao, Ozon e Ikea, lo que evidencia un desplazamiento desde el comercio minorista tradicional hacia servicios digitales con grandes bases de usuarios y operaciones frecuentes.
PUBLICIDAD
Plataformas de pago, otro blanco prioritario
No solo las plataformas de entretenimiento y compras están en la mira. El informe de la compañía de ciberseguridad destaca que los sistemas de pago siguen siendo un objetivo principal para el phishing.
A nivel global, Mastercard lidera la lista (33%), seguida por Visa (20%), Paypal (14%) y American Express (4%). Los atacantes buscan suplantar redes de tarjetas bancarias que cuentan con millones de usuarios y una alta frecuencia de transacciones.
PUBLICIDAD
La popularidad y presencia cotidiana de estas marcas las convierte en un recurso muy atractivo para los ciberdelincuentes, que aprovechan la confianza de los usuarios para que sus mensajes y páginas fraudulentas parezcan legítimos.
Cómo operan las estafas y por qué son tan efectivas
Los ciberdelincuentes diseñan correos electrónicos, mensajes de texto y sitios web falsos que imitan de forma precisa la identidad visual y los procesos de las marcas originales. Ofrecen descuentos irresistibles, acceso exclusivo o alertas de seguridad para engañar a las víctimas y obtener datos personales, contraseñas o información bancaria.
PUBLICIDAD
Leandro Cuozzo, analista Senior de Seguridad en el Equipo Global de Investigación y Análisis para América Latina de Kaspersky, advierte que la familiaridad y la presencia constante de estas plataformas en la vida diaria hacen que los usuarios bajen la guardia.
“Cuanto más familiar resulta una plataforma, más fácil es que una víctima caiga en la trampa, por ello, los usuarios deben mantenerse alerta ante técnicas de ataque cada vez más sofisticadas y personalizadas”, comentó el analista de ciberseguridad.
PUBLICIDAD
Consejos clave para evitar caer en estafas digitales
Para protegerse frente a estas amenazas, los expertos recomiendan:
- Verificar la dirección de los sitios web: Comprobar que la URL comienza con el nombre oficial de la empresa y que no contiene errores gramaticales o términos genéricos. La ausencia del nombre real es una alerta importante.
- Desconfiar de mensajes con ventajas exageradas: Las ofertas “gratis”, grandes descuentos o premios inesperados suelen ser ganchos en campañas de phishing asociadas a marcas populares.
- Evitar acceder a plataformas desde enlaces en correos o mensajes: Siempre es preferible ingresar directamente a la web oficial o a la app. Antes de introducir datos personales o bancarios, asegurarse de que se trata del sitio legítimo.
- Utilizar soluciones de ciberseguridad robustas: Contar con un software de seguridad actualizado en el dispositivo móvil y en la computadora ayuda a detectar y bloquear intentos de phishing y malware.
El auge del phishing y las estafas asociadas a marcas como Spotify y Netflix pone de manifiesto la necesidad de una mayor educación digital en América Latina. La familiaridad con las plataformas no debe traducirse en confianza ciega. Adoptar buenos hábitos de seguridad, mantenerse informado y utilizar tecnologías de protección son pasos fundamentales para prevenir fraudes y proteger la identidad y los datos financieros en el entorno digital.

articles.title: Melhor tablet para trabalho em 2026: 10 modelos para comprar no Brasil • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Melhor tablet para trabalho em 2026: 10 modelos para comprar no Brasil
Selecionamos tablets com bom desempenho, bateria duradoura e suporte a caneta e teclado para aumentar sua produtividade no trabalho
O melhor tablet para trabalho deve atender às suas demandas profissionais: modelos avançados são indicados para quem precisa de mobilidade sem abrir mão de desempenho, servindo para tarefas mais exigentes, como edição de vídeos, ilustrações e projetos 3D. Já tablets mais simples podem lidar com troca de e-mails e tarefas mais administrativas, oferecendo boas relações de custo-benefício.
A seguir, o Tecnoblog lista 10 opções de tablet para trabalho em diversas faixas de preço. Confira prós e contras de modelos da Apple, Samsung, Vaio, Lenovo e Huawei.
O iPad Pro (2025) é o tablet mais potente da Apple atualmente, equipado com o chip M5 (3 nm) e 12 GB ou 16 GB de memória unificada. Com ele, você pode lidar com cargas de trabalho exigentes e ainda pode automatizar tarefas com os recursos da Apple Intelligence.
A tela Ultra Retina XDR de 11″ ou 13″ oferece boa fluidez com taxa de atualização de até 120 Hz. Fora isso, um sistema de janelas redesenhado do iPadOS 26 permite dividir a tela em três ou quatro partes para otimizar o multitasking.
A bateria de 31,29 Wh (11″) ou 38,99 Wh (13″) promete autonomia para um dia inteiro. E a versão Wi-Fi + cellular permite que você se conecte à internet via rede móvel 5G para manter-se produtivo em qualquer lugar.
O Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra é o concorrente direto do iPad Pro. O tablet combina o chipset MediaTek Dimensity 9400+ (3 nm) com 12 GB de RAM para entregar desempenho de ponta em multitarefas e atividades pesadas. Também há suporte ao Galaxy AI para ainda mais produtividade.
A tela AMOLED Dinâmico 2X de 14,6″ é fluida (120 Hz) e garante ampla visualização de conteúdos. Já a compatibilidade com o Samsung DeX permite criar até quatro áreas de trabalho e mover apps entre telas.
A bateria de 11.600 mAh do aparelho também se destaca, com autonomia para até 23 horas em reprodução de vídeos. Contudo, a versão vendida no Brasil se limita à conectividade Wi-Fi, sem suporte para redes móveis.
O iPad Air (2026) é menos potente que o iPad Pro, mas também consegue rodar apps profissionais e tarefas mais intensas. Para isso, o dispositivo traz o chip M4 (3 nm) aliado a 12 GB de memória unificada para otimizar a performance em multitarefas.
A versão com tela de 13″ oferece uma área de trabalho maior para quem costuma usar várias ferramentas ao mesmo tempo. Já o modelo de 11″ é menor e mais leve, facilitando a portabilidade. Ambas as variantes contam com telas Liquid Retina.
A bateria Li-Po de 28,93 Wh (11″) ou 36,59 Wh (13″) dura até 10 horas de navegação Wi-Fi. Por falar em conexão, a variante Wi-Fi + cellular suporta rede móvel 5G, mas é relativamente mais cara que a variante base.
O Galaxy Tab S10 FE+ chega com o chip Exynos 1580 (4 nm) e 8 GB de RAM. O hardware não é indicado para cargas profissionais muito pesadas, mas oferece desempenho equilibrado para atividades menos intensas e multitarefas.
Aliás, o recurso Múltiplas Janelas permite dividir a tela LCD (de 10,9″ ou 13,1″) em até três seções para aumentar a produtividade. Já a taxa de atualização de 90 Hz torna as animações mais fluidas durante o trabalho.
A bateria de 8.000 mAh promete autonomia de até 21 horas em reprodução de vídeo. Também há uma variante compatível com 5G, caso precise ficar online longe do escritório ou de casa.
O iPad (2025) usa o chip A16 Bionic (4 nm) e possui 6 GB de RAM. O dispositivo tem desempenho sólido em apps de produtividade mais leves, mas tende a travar em tarefas exigentes como renderização. Não há suporte para o Apple Intelligence.
Por ser um iPad mais simples, a tela de 11″ tem taxa de atualização de apenas 60 Hz, sendo menos fluida. Em compensação, o recurso Stage Manager facilita a organização de apps exibidos no display, o que otimiza a produtividade.
A bateria com capacidade de 28,93 Wh pode durar até 10 horas de navegação web. Você também pode otimizar o fluxo profissional com a Apple Pencil e Magic Keyboard Folio, mas os acessórios são vendidos separadamente.
O Lenovo Idea Tab Pro oferece performance equilibrada para cargas de trabalho intermediárias e até mais exigentes. Para isso, o tablet combina o processador MediaTek Dimensity 8300 (4 nm) com 8 GB ou 12 GB de RAM.
A tela nítida de 12,7″ tem resolução 3K e garante ótima fluidez de rolagem devido à taxa de atualização de 144 Hz. A compatibilidade com a caneta Pen Plus também proporciona mais produtividade para anotações no display.
Para mais autonomia longe das tomadas, o tablet inclui uma bateria de 10.200 mAh com suporte para carregamento rápido de até 45 W. Contudo, não há suporte para rede móvel.
O Galaxy Tab S10 Lite é um dispositivo de produtividade mais básico, sendo ideal para troca de e-mails e análise de planilhas. Ele conta com o chip Exynos 1380 (5 nm) e 6 GB ou 8 GB de RAM — recomendamos a versão com mais memória para evitar travamentos em multitarefas.
A tela LCD de 10,9″ tem taxa de atualização de 90 Hz e certificação SGS para reduzir a fadiga ocular em sessões prolongadas. O display também é compatível com o recurso Tela Dividida para visualização de dois ou mais aplicativos simultaneamente.
Um dos principais pontos fortes do tablet está na bateria de 8.000 mAh, que promete autonomia para um dia completo de trabalho. A versão base chega apenas com Wi-Fi, mas você pode garantir conexão via rede móvel na variante 5G.
O Vaio TL 12 é um tablet intermediário alimentado pelo chip UNISOC T820 (6 nm) e 8 GB ou 12 GB de RAM. O dispositivo é voltado para produtividade, mas tende a engasgar em tarefas muito complexas como edições de vídeo e modelagem 3D.
A tela AMOLED de 12,6″ oferece resolução de 2.5K, embora seja limitada à taxa de atualização de 60 Hz. Em compensação, o display é compatível com a Vaio Pen (inclusa na caixa) para anotações ou mesmo ilustrações.
O dispositivo ainda conta com bateria de 10.090 mAh para mais autonomia na rotina. Também há suporte nativo para 5G, habilitando conexões à internet via chip SIM.
O Huawei MatePad SE 11 é voltado para cargas de trabalho leves, devido às limitações do chip Kirin 710A (14 nm). A versão oficial vendida no Brasil tem 6 GB RAM, mas também há variantes com 4 GB ou 8 GB que podem ser importadas.
O recurso Colaboração Multitelas aumenta a produtividade ao permitir o uso do tablet com outro monitores de aparelhos Huawei. Fora isso, também há uma função multijanelas para otimizar o uso simultâneo de vários apps na tela LCD de 11 polegadas.
A bateria tem 7.700 mAh de capacidade e pode durar um dia inteiro. A caixa acompanha a caneta M-Pen Lite, mas você precisará adquirir teclados compatíveis à parte.
O Lenovo Idea Tab é uma versão bem mais modesta que a variante Pro, com chip MediaTek Dimensity 6300 (6 nm) e 4 GB, 6 GB ou 8 GB de RAM. Por isso, o tablet performa melhor em análise de planilhas, troca de e-mails, entre outras tarefas mais básicas.
O display de 11″ entrega boa fluidez com taxa de atualização de 90 Hz. Ele também é compatível com a Lenovo Tab Pen (inclusa na caixa) que facilita anotações e produtividade em geral.
Em nossa análise, a bateria de 7.040 mAh suportou um dia inteiro de uso cotidiano. Em contrapartida, a recarga levou mais de duas horas com o adaptador de 20 W incluso na caixa.
Ao escolher o melhor tablet para trabalho, considere especificações que ajudam a aumentar sua produtividade e oferecem mais autonomia de uso. Vale considerar aspectos como:
O Galaxy Tab S10 Lite é o melhor tablet custo-benefício para trabalho. O dispositivo tem performance equilibrada para atividades mais simples e inclui uma bateria com boa capacidade. Além disso, capa e caneta acompanham o tablet na caixa.
O Lenovo Idea Tab é um tablet bom e barato para trabalho. O aparelho é voltado para tarefas menos exigentes, mas traz uma tela fluida e ainda acompanha caneta, capa e teclado para aumentar sua produtividade.
Os tablets com caneta da lista incluem os modelos Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra, Vaio TL12, Galaxy Tab S10 FE+, Galaxy Tab S10 Lite, Lenovo Idea Tab Pro, Huawei MatePad SE 11 e Lenovo Idea Tab.
Depende. Os iPads da Apple são referência para quem trabalha com design e ilustração por serem compatíveis com softwares da área bem completos. Esses aparelhos também são mais aconselháveis se você tem iPhone e quer uma integração mais otimizada para o ecossistema da Apple.
Já tablets Android oferecem mais variedade de modelos, incluindo variantes mais básicas se você precisa executar apenas cargas de trabalho simples. Se você já usa um smartphone Android, vale apostar nesses dispositivos pela familiaridade com o sistema e recursos de integração mais apropriados.
Sim, dependendo da atividade. Tablets para trabalho podem lidar com tarefas administrativas, reuniões e até atividades mais complexas. A experiência fica ainda mais próxima de um notebook se você também usar acessórios, como teclado e mouse sem fio.
Contudo, há softwares com versões completas limitadas a sistemas operacionais Windows, macOS ou Linux. Para esses casos, será preciso usar um notebook ao invés de um tablet.

articles.title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Jumped By 436% in a Single Day After Netflix Reveal, As PS5 Dominates Xbox
articles.text:
Monday, August 31st 2026
	
									
	
	
	
GTA 6 Pre-Orders Jumped By 436% in a Single Day After Netflix Reveal, As PS5 Dominates Xbox
Grand Theft Auto 6 pre-orders jumped sharply after Rockstar's extended gameplay look aired on Netflix, according to new estimates from Sensor Tower. The analytics firm says pre-orders rose 436% on August 27, the day of the showcase, compared to the day before. That momentum carried into August 28, pushing the two-day increase to 572% against the prior 30-day average. PlayStation 5 accounted for the bulk of the surge, with PS5 pre-orders up 606% on the 27th alone, while Xbox Series X|S pre-orders rose a comparatively modest 127%. PS5 has led Xbox in GTA 6 pre-orders since Sensor Tower began tracking reservations in June, shortly after Rockstar officially opened pre-orders for the game. 
Sensor Tower's cumulative estimate now stands at roughly 4.86 million pre-orders worldwide, worth close to $476 million, with PlayStation buyers accounting for about 77% of that total. Take-Two has not confirmed exact figures, though CEO Strauss Zelnick has previously said demand for the $100 Ultimate Edition has outpaced the standard $80 version. Rockstar has kept a tight grip on gameplay reveals since GTA 6's earlier trailers, so a 26-minute showcase was always going to move the needle. Sensor Tower's own analysts have also suggested the current Ultimate Edition divide is unlikely to hold once mass-market buyers start pre-ordering closer to release, which could shift these percentages again before launch.

articles.title: Bank of England governor warns of AI-related financial system risks - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Bank of England governor warns of AI-related financial system risks
Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey today warned that advanced artificial intelligence poses risks to financial infrastructure.
Bailey outlined his concerns in a letter to G20 finance ministers and central bank governors. The document was made public shortly before the group convened in Asheville, North Carolina for its annual meeting. Bailey penned the document in his capacity as the chair of the Financial Stability Board, an international body that oversees the health of the financial system.
The letter warns that financial markets are vulnerable to a correction because of multiple “fragilities.” Bailey listed “stretched asset valuations” in the AI market as one such fragility. He also pointed to the role of debt in circular investment deals between AI companies and hyperscalers.
The rest of the two-page document mostly focuses on large language models’ ability to launch cyberattacks.
According to Bailey, one reason frontier LLMs pose a risk is that many important financial systems are interconnected. The world’s top investment firms complete numerous transactions with one another each day. Furthermore, they often do so using technology from the same third-party providers. A breach at such a key provider can potentially compromise multiple financial institutions.
The letter goes on to make several cybersecurity suggestions for the industry. Bailey recommends that decision-makers prepare for disruptions that affect multiple financial institutions or technology suppliers at once. He also calls for the implementation of workflows that make it possible to “restore critical systems and data from ‘bare metal’ following a significant cyber incident.” Bare metal servers are machines that lack an operating system.
The letter notes that AI models’ ability to rapidly spot software vulnerabilities will require banks to roll out patches faster. That’s challenging for multiple reasons. When a new exploit is discovered, engineers must not develop a patch but also test that it works as expected before releasing it. The latter task historically involved a significant amount of manual work.
“Frontier AI offers significant opportunities to strengthen cyber defence; but recent developments highlight the importance of ensuring that advances in capability are matched by resilience and preparedness,” Bailey wrote.
Last week, more than 100 banks, tech firms and other companies published a public letter warning about the cybersecurity risks of AI. The signatories believe that the frequency of LLM-driven hacking campaigns will increase significantly in the coming months. The letter urges organizations to bolster their defenses by providing their technology teams with AI cybersecurity tools.

articles.title: The Anker Solix E10 home backup stopped me worrying about power outages
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
The Anker Solix E10 is a spectacular all-home battery backup system that gives the flexibility of expanding with more units, adding on solar, and more peace of mind. It adds a generator that can be powered via natural gas, propane, or gasoline, giving it truly one of the best all-around backup solutions on the market.
Pros
- +Expandable Battery stack
- +Solar input optional
- +Tri-fuel smart generator
- +App control
- +Sleek design
- +Transfer switch
Cons
- -Price
- -Needs Wi-Fi for setup
Why you can trust TechRadar
I have become quite the expert when it comes to portable power stations. It's definitely a weird flex, but I'll take it when I can get it.
When it comes to power stations, there are several different categories of how they are scaled. Some can run your phone, some can run your fridge, some can run your room, and some can run your house.
The Anker Solix E10 is on that home side. The company calls it "a Whole-Home Backup System, uniting battery, solar and a smart generator." And that's absolutely - and impressively - what it does.
It can scale up to where it could be a larger home and scale down to where it'll be a smaller home, or maybe a large garage, depending on what all you have in your garage.
The point is that it is a power station comparable to probably a Tesla Power Wall, as a lot of people would recognize just due to the brand name. It is not only a reservoir of power that you can pull from in case of a power outage, but also a transfer switch.
It has the ability to connect with solar panels to intake solar power from the sun and utilize that to run your home. Depending on the power company, you have potentially even kicked back some power to the grid and gotten yourself a return.
If you run out of power in case of emergency and you don't have enough solar to run your entire home, you can even connect to a portable smart generator that happens to be tri-fuel. That means you could then run that off of natural gas, propane gas, or gasoline.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
So at the end of the day, over the last 141 days that I have had this set up at my home, I have not once worried about a power outage or a storm that's coming, knocking out my power and causing food to spoil or for my kids to panic. In fact, I've welcomed several storms and excitement, actually, to test the system.
Anker Solix E10: Price and availability
Depending on how many batteries and accessories you get, your price is going to change pretty aggressively with this setup, especially if you start counting in install costs as well.
Your base system with one inverter and one battery is going to cost just over $4,000. Once you get up to the Basecamp Power Dock Smart Generator, you get up to $10,000 pretty easily.
You can get these through Anker or Amazon. One thing you will want to note is that, unless you are a licensed electrician, you're going to need to get one to get this all installed. Mine even had to consult with the city code and the utility company in order to get everything approved, since I am tied into the power grid.
Anker Solix E10: Unboxing and First Impressions
My entire setup showed up on a semi truck off a pallet because I got several batteries, the inverter, the generator, and other components needed to help with install.
From the first moment I started unboxing everything and looking at the quality, I was blown away with how sharp this looked. Once I found out that this was going to have to get strapped to the side of my house, I actually wasn't that upset because it looks so sleek and professional.
It doesn't look like it's some toy or cheap product that needs to be mounted, but actually it looks like it's floating. It looks like it's an addition to my home, not just a slap-it-on-the-side. It looks intentional.
Anker Solix E10: Design & Build Quality
Like I mentioned, I needed to have a licensed electrician install this, but once he installed it and handed it over to me, the setup process within the app was significantly easier than I'm sure his job was. All I had to do was pair the already set-up device to my app, answer a few questions on how the system was set up, and then I was good to go.
Now I have the ability to run more isolated breakers if I'd like. I can see my power output level. I can see when the smart generator is hooked up and trigger when and how to turn that on. I can check my battery levels.
Another huge thing that I noticed right away is that, much like some of the other units from Anker Solix, I can have my location set so that when there's a storm coming in, it will automatically top my batteries off.
Meaning that I can let them idle and sit at around 80%, maybe 90%, during the winter. When there's a storm, they will automatically top themselves off to help with the longevity of the battery while also still getting the benefit of having the entire battery's capacity when needed.
At first, I was thinking that I would need to have this installed in my garage, but once I found out that it was rated for extreme weather, extreme cold, and even extreme heat, I knew that I could have this outside my home, even in my Midwest temperament, and be just fine.
Anker Solix E10: In use
One of these days I'll get solar added to my roof, but according to what I'm seeing, it looks like the solar input can take up to 9,000 W with two batteries which is madness if you ask me.
What I can speak to is the smart generator. I've tried it both with propane and with gasoline, and both have worked very well. It's a smart generator, meaning that it can automatically trigger when needed based on my E10 power panel, so already I'm a step ahead.
This feels almost like a Generac kind of style, where it will kick on when needed, but what's really cool is that I can disconnect and utilize this as just a generator if I ever needed it as well. If I'm working out on a property somewhere else, or my cabin property, or anything like that, I could bring this generator and get power immediately wherever I need it.
The other nice thing about this generator is that, since it is a smart generator, it has push-to-start, so I won't ever have to rip on that cord unless there's something that's going wrong. Lastly, this generator starts up pretty quickly and has its own built-in Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, so I can pair it to my app independently of the E10 power wall. It runs fairly quietly.
I've tested several times and barely notice it kicking on, and I don't notice it kicking on. When it comes to the power output on the inside, it seamlessly transitions, and I haven't even noticed a flicker or the inside of my house recognizing that there's power loss at all.
It's genuinely a bit hard for me to understand sometimes, even being in this world, but this one little generator has been able to run my entire home when testing. I've intentionally made the system go off-grid, and then my house will run simply off of this generator, and there have been zero drops in ability.
Admittedly, I'm not charging a car off of my house or anything else insane while doing that, but a full house with two fridges, microwaves, air fryers, two-stage HVAC, and 3,000 sq. ft., plus a basement. I've had zero issues running off of this one simple generator.
I used to have the F3800 Whole-home backup system through Anker. While that worked and was solid, I was very aware of the battery capacity, just in case there was ever an issue. Now, though, I don't have any concern at all because, worst-case scenario, I can run off of gasoline.
If I run out of gasoline, I can run off my two propane tanks that I have at the house. While I'm running those, I can go and get more gas if I needed to, or more propane. Down the road, I could hook up to my natural gas line as well.
This may not be for everyone, but I have had a hard time pointing people away from it when I've talked to Dee about Whole Home Backup Systems. Other than, of course, the cost and the fact that this is slightly different than what people have gotten used to when it comes to a Generac or Tesla Powerwall. When I explain just how beneficial my system is, it definitely gets their head turning and gets them interested in this for their own.
One final positive note is that down the road, if I choose to get an electric vehicle or expand or want to have some additional power outside of my house, I could run an independent circuit directly from this Powerwall and then control it from my phone. Anker allows me to customize the output, the schedule, and the control of the circuit independently from my house, and I can do it all from my phone.
Anker Solix E10: Final verdict
The Anker Solix E10 Powerwall makes incredible sense for most homeowners, especially those who are looking for some flexibility and want to have the gas, propane, or natural gas backed up as well. Not only can I use this as a whole-home backup system, but then I can actually use each piece independently for more than what they originally used it for.
It is, of course, a bit of a headache having to consult with the local electric company to ensure that you can hook up your system in line with the grid, because that is a very real concern. It did cause some delay for my install; however, if you can get that solved, this is an absolute no-brainer for me.

articles.title: InsuranceDekho, RenewBuy announce merger to build pan-India insurance distribution platform
articles.text:
InsuranceDekho, RenewBuy announce merger to build pan-India insurance distribution platform
The combined entity will have a pan-India presence, with a premium book of over Rs 6,600 crore in FY26.
Two insurtech startups, InsuranceDekho and RenewBuy, have announced a merger to build a pan-India insurance distribution platform.
According to a company statement, the combined entity will bring together InsuranceDekho’s strong presence in northern and western India with RenewBuy’s network in the south. The merged business will have a premium book of over Rs 6,600 crore, more than six lakh digital partners, and coverage across 98.57% of India’s pin codes as of March 31, 2026.
The combined business will operate under the InsuranceDekho brand, with Ankit Agrawal, Founder of InsuranceDekho, leading the unified entity.
The founders of both companies will continue with the merged organisation, the statement said, ensuring continuity in leadership, execution, and long-term strategy.
Together, the two companies have facilitated the issuance of more than two crore insurance policies since inception as of March 31, 2026.
On the merger, Ankit Agrawal, Founder & CEO, InsuranceDekho, said, "This combination brings together complementary strengths in technology, on-ground distribution and insurer partnerships. Our immediate focus is disciplined execution and seamless integration."
The combined company’s technology strengths are expected to support automated partner onboarding which will include integrated digital onboarding, policy issuance and AI-powered advisory. This development is also expected to work on the intersection of insurance, AI and distribution.
RenewBuy CEO Balachander Sekhar said, “By pairing technology depth with skilled on-ground partner network capabilities, we can equip insurance partners with smarter tools and seamless digital experiences - and, through them, aim to bring insurance within reach of every Indian.”
InsuranceDekho’s portfolio spans motor, health, life, travel, and corporate insurance, offering 750+ insurance products from 52 insurers. This startup has raised funding from Beams Fintech Fund and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group. RenewBuy is backed by Dai-ichi-Life Holdings.
Both these startups are headquartered in Gurugram.

articles.title: SpaceX : il faudrait jusqu'à 130 milliards de dollars pour créer son propre réseau de téléphonie mobile
articles.text:
SpaceX souhaite à l'avenir pouvoir proposer un grand service de téléphonie mobile. Mais selon l'option choisie, les coûts de ce projet pourraient être incroyablement élevés !
Le service d'internet par satellites Starlink, opéré par SpaceX, est un tel succès ces dernières années que la compagnie d'Elon Musk a voulu pousser le concept plus loin. Le prochain grand chantier du géant américain se retrouve en effet du côté de la téléphonie mobile assurée par un service satellite, le fameux service direct-to-cell - encore proposé bénévolement en France cet été à l'occasion des grands incendies. Mais pour faire de ce projet un service totalement indépendant, il faudrait des milliards en cascade !
Une activité mobile avec un réseau terrestre pourrait coûter entre 50 et 130 milliards de dollars à SpaceX
Aujourd'hui, SpaceX propose déjà son service téléphonie mobile par satellite direct-to-cell dans plusieurs pays, dont les États-Unis. Mais si le géant veut passer une nouvelle étape, et devenir un véritable opérateur mobile totalement indépendant, il lui faudrait payer énormément.
C'est ce qu'indique une nouvelle étude du cabinet Bernstein. D'après cette dernière, il faudrait investir entre 50 et 130 milliards de dollars à SpaceX pour se doter aux États-Unis d'un réseau de téléphonie mobile complètement indépendant - contrairement à aujourd'hui, où SpaceX se contente d'emprunter les fréquences terrestres d'opérateurs partenaires.
L'option du partenariat, la plus probable ?
Les 50 milliards de dollars correspondent à l'option d'un réseau minimaliste, quand l'option de base, centrale, de l'étude parle de 70 milliards de dollars d'investissement. Il permettrait de déployer 57 000 antennes macro, et de racheter les fréquences basses de Grain Management - une hypothèse dont Bloomberg s'est récemment fait l'écho.
Enfin, les 130 milliards de dollars correspondent à l'éventualité où SpaceX souhaiterait se mettre au niveau des monstres américains, comme T-Mobile, avec l'achat massif de fréquences et le déploiement de quelque 120 000 antennes. Reste qu'à ce jour, le cabinet Bernstein penche pour le scénario du maintient des partenariats avec les opérateurs mobile pour le service Direct-to-cell, celui-ci étant le moins coûteux. Mais sera-ce l'orientation que prendra Elon Musk ?

articles.title: La quinta potencia militar del mundo ha comenzado a entregar tanques Black Panther a un país europeo amenazada por Rusia. Marruecos también lo quiere
articles.text:
Corea del Sur se ha convertido en uno de los grandes beneficiados del rearme internacional provocado por la guerra de Ucrania. El país, situado actualmente en el quinto puesto del ranking militar de Global Firepower, acaba de iniciar una nueva fase de entregas de sus K2 Black Panther.
Los envíos. El primer país está siendo Polonia, uno de los miembros de la OTAN más expuestos a la amenaza rusa. No solo eso, mientras Varsovia proyecta una gigantesca flota de hasta 1.000 unidades, el éxito internacional del carro surcoreano empieza a llamar la atención mucho más lejos de Europa: Marruecos estudia ahora una posible adquisición de hasta 400 K2.
La quinta potencia militar enviando a Europa. Corea del Sur ha comenzado las entregas correspondientes al segundo gran contrato de K2 Black Panther firmado entre Polonia y Hyundai Rotem, valorado en unos 6.500 millones de dólares y compuesto por otros 180 carros de combate.
Los primeros 28 vehículos de esta nueva tanda ya han llegado al país y están destinados a reforzar la 16ª División Mecanizada, desplegada en el noreste polaco. No es una ubicación cualquiera: Polonia comparte frontera con Bielorrusia y con el enclave ruso de Kaliningrado, convirtiendo esa región en uno de los espacios estratégicamente más sensibles del flanco oriental de la OTAN.
Y Polonia envía a Ucrania. La apuesta polaca por el K2 está directamente relacionada con la transformación que sufrió su ejército después de la invasión rusa de Ucrania. Varsovia se convirtió en uno de los principales proveedores europeos de material pesado para Kiev y transfirió cientos de carros de origen soviético, incluidos numerosos T-72, reduciendo considerablemente sus propias reservas.
Eso creó una necesidad extraordinariamente urgente: no bastaba con comprar un tanque moderno, Polonia necesitaba un fabricante capaz de producirlo y entregarlo rápidamente, y la enorme capacidad industrial surcoreana ofrecía precisamente esa combinación.
De compra urgente a flota de hasta 1.000. Los primeros acuerdos con Seúl estaban pensados para reconstruir rápidamente las unidades acorazadas polacas, pero el proyecto ha terminado convirtiéndose en algo mucho más ambicioso. Varsovia contempla llegar a disponer de hasta 1.000 K2, una cifra que convertiría al carro surcoreano en una de las columnas vertebrales de sus fuerzas terrestres durante las próximas décadas.
El segundo contrato por 180 unidades confirma esa transición: el Black Panther ya no funciona simplemente como sustituto provisional del material enviado a Ucrania, sino como una plataforma alrededor de la cual Polonia pretende reorganizar una parte considerable de su capacidad acorazada.
Rusia acelera el rearme. La velocidad de este programa se entiende mejor observando lo que ocurre alrededor de las fronteras polacas. Como hemos ido contando, Varsovia ha denunciado diferentes violaciones de su espacio aéreo relacionadas con ataques rusos contra Ucrania y llegó a convocar al embajador ruso después de que un misil de crucero Kh-101 penetrara en territorio polaco y acabara estrellándose en el este del país.
Contaba Reuters que las autoridades polacas consideran estos episodios una demostración de que la guerra puede generar incidentes directamente sobre territorio de la OTAN y han convertido el fortalecimiento de las defensas orientales en una prioridad estratégica a largo plazo.
Corea y el hueco europeo. El éxito del K2 revela también un cambio importante en el mercado internacional de armamento. Corea del Sur combina una industria militar avanzada con enormes capacidades productivas, precios competitivos y, especialmente, plazos de entrega difíciles de igualar por fabricantes occidentales sometidos a décadas de reducción de pedidos y líneas de producción.
Polonia ha acompañado los K2 con otras grandes adquisiciones surcoreanas, convirtiendo a Seúl en un socio fundamental de su modernización militar y demostrando que un país situado a miles de kilómetros puede ocupar rápidamente el espacio abierto por las necesidades urgentes de los ejércitos europeos.
El Black Panther mira más allá de Europa. Sí, porque ese éxito internacional empieza a despertar interés en el norte de África. Marruecos estaría evaluando técnica y estratégicamente la incorporación de hasta 400 K2 Black Panther para modernizar sus fuerzas acorazadas, atraído entre otras características por su elevada movilidad, automatización y tripulación de tres personas.
El movimiento permitiría además a Rabat diversificar una flota históricamente apoyada en material estadounidense y diferentes plataformas de otros orígenes, aunque existe una diferencia fundamental respecto al caso polaco: por ahora se trata de una evaluación de viabilidad y no hay ningún contrato firmado para adquirir esos 400 carros.
Un escaparate mundial. Si se quiere también, el K2 resume una transformación que va bastante más allá de un único modelo de tanque. Corea del Sur, situada en el quinto puesto del índice de Global Firepower, está utilizando su extraordinaria capacidad industrial para ganar terreno en un mercado alterado por la guerra de Ucrania y el aumento mundial del gasto en defensa.
Polonia representa su escaparate más espectacular, con la perspectiva de operar hasta un millar de Black Panther; que Marruecos esté estudiando ahora centenares de ellos muestra hasta qué punto una compra nacida de la urgencia europea puede terminar convirtiendo al tanque surcoreano en una plataforma global.

articles.title: Qué cantidad de comida cabe en una freidora de aire de 5 litros
articles.text:
Uno de los errores más comunes al usar una freidora de aire es intentar colocar más alimento de lo sugerido por el fabricante en su cesta. Esta práctica, aunque parezca inofensiva, puede afectar la cocción y la textura de los alimentos, provocando resultados poco satisfactorios y, en algunos casos, reduciendo la vida útil del aparato.
El exceso de comida impide que el aire circule adecuadamente, lo que redunda en preparaciones desiguales y en la pérdida de los beneficios asociados a este electrodoméstico. En este sentido, se explica cómo usar una freidora de aire de 5 litros sin sobrecargarla.
PUBLICIDAD
Cuánto pollo se puede meter en una freidora de aire de 5 litros
La freidora de aire de 5 litros permite preparar diferentes cortes de pollo, siempre que se respete su capacidad máxima. Para filetes de pechuga, como los que suelen encontrarse en bolsas de supermercado, el espacio admite hasta cinco unidades por tanda.
En el caso de productos empanizados como los nuggets, la cesta admite hasta 700 gramos por ciclo de cocción. Esta cifra corresponde a una cantidad ideal para una comida familiar o para reuniones pequeñas, sin poner en riesgo la correcta cocción ni la integridad del electrodoméstico.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué cantidad de pescado es posible cocinar al mismo tiempo en la freidora de aire
Cocinar pescado en una freidora de aire de 5 litros ofrece la ventaja adicional de minimizar los olores que suelen impregnar la cocina tras una fritura tradicional.
La capacidad permite cocinar tres filetes medianos de pescado, lo que equivale a aproximadamente 600 gramos. Esta cantidad es suficiente para una comida individual o para dos personas, dependiendo del tamaño de las porciones.
PUBLICIDAD
Estos filetes deben colocarse de forma que no se superpongan, garantizando así una cocción pareja. Esta disposición maximiza el rendimiento del aparato y permite disfrutar de pescado con exterior dorado sin que se reseque el interior.
Asimismo, la limpieza posterior resulta más sencilla, porque los residuos se reducen considerablemente gracias a la cocción por aire caliente.
Cuántas papas, panes y masas pueden prepararse sin sobrecargar el aparato
En cuanto a papas, la freidora admite hasta 700 gramos en cualquiera de sus presentaciones, ya sean papas fritas, duquesas o doradas. Esta cantidad asegura que las papas queden doradas por fuera y tiernas por dentro, sin necesidad de añadir muchas cantidades de aceite.
PUBLICIDAD
Respecto al pan, el electrodoméstico puede recibir hasta cuatro unidades de pan de molde, de hamburguesa o marraqueta, mientras que para pan de hot dog el máximo sugerido es cinco piezas, siempre que se acomoden de forma ordenada.
En el caso de masas, la versatilidad de la freidora permite cocinar una lasaña de cuatro porciones o una pizza para dos personas; y, pueden prepararse hasta ocho tortas fritas de tamaño estándar en una sola tanda.
PUBLICIDAD
En cuanto a la cocción de la carne, la cesta puede integrar hasta tres bistecs de tamaño promedio o cuatro hamburguesas medianas. Si se opta por albóndigas, el límite es de doce unidades por tanda.
Qué pautas deben tenerse al limpiar la freidora tras cada uso
Sumado a respetar la capacidad máxima, la limpieza adecuada del electrodoméstico es esencial para mantener su funcionamiento y evitar la acumulación de residuos. Se sugiere esperar al menos 30 minutos tras el uso para que el aparato enfríe completamente antes de proceder con la limpieza.
PUBLICIDAD
El cesto puede lavarse con detergente y un elemento no abrasivo o colocarse en el lavavajillas, mientras que el cuerpo principal nunca debe sumergirse en agua para evitar daños en el cable de alimentación.
Mantener estos cuidados y respetar la capacidad de la freidora de aire de 5 litros contribuye a obtener mejores resultados en cada preparación y prolonga la vida útil del aparato.

articles.title: Samsung reveals three-phase HBM roadmap that puts logic and compute inside memory — zHBM ultimately stacks DRAM directly on top of the processor
articles.text:
Hot Chips 2026: Samsung reveals a three-phase HBM roadmap that puts logic and compute inside memory — zHBM ultimately stacks DRAM directly on top of the processor
XPU and memory become one
Samsung has unveiled a three-phase roadmap to progressively transform high-bandwidth memory (HBM) into an integrated memory-and-compute system, culminating in the company's zHBM architecture, which places the processor directly beneath the DRAM stack and eliminates the conventional 2.5D interposer link between the two. Detailing the roadmap at Hot Chips 2026, Samsung's Sangwook Han, of the company's DRAM design team, identified the base die as the key enabler of the evolution, which began with the company’s decision to manufacture the HBM base die on an advanced logic process.
In conventional HBM, the base die (B-die) was fabricated on the same DRAM process node as the core dies (C-dies) in the stack above. Starting with HBM4, Samsung moved the base die to a 4nm logic process, primarily to reduce power draw and minimize die area. Additionally, it gave Samsung a much more capable piece of silicon.
The company contends that a die built on the same class of logic process as XPUs could do much more than serve as a data interface. Samsung now plans to progressively offload more functions into the base die, eventually removing the physical gap between memory and the XPU entirely.
The current state of HBM and its growing constraints
The current HBM architecture comprises multiple DRAM core dies stacked vertically on a base die and connected through thousands of TSVs. The stack sits beside an XPU on an interposer, with the base die bridging the memory and compute silicon.
Bandwidth has been the main driver of HBM’s evolution. The current HBM4 stack has roughly 1 to 5 TB/s of bandwidth obtained through 1,000 to 2,000 I/Os running at about 8 to 16 Gbps each. These figures are expected to rise with upcoming HBM generations. The problem is that conventional ways of scaling bandwidth present significant challenges.
TSV signaling speed is difficult to increase, so HBM generations have added more TSVs instead. However, this consumes area and forces tighter TSV pitches. The PHY has also grown more demanding. HBM4 doubled the data I/O count from 1,024 to 2,048 DQs, and signaling speed keeps rising. Power is an even bigger issue. While energy per bit is improving, total HBM power continues to rise as bandwidth is scaling faster. Samsung says this is why HBM4 moves the base die to an advanced logic process, as the denser, more efficient logic reduces power draw.
This move underpins and enables the three-phase plan. An advanced logic node shrinks the interface circuitry while enabling the HBM base die to perform functions previously handled by the processor. Samsung calls this direction custom HBM, or cHBM, which keeps the conventional DRAM stack but customizes the logic underneath it for a specific accelerator.
Phase 1: Reclaim XPU area
The first phase is about handing processor area back to compute in what Samsung calls “XPU area reclamation.” AI accelerators are hitting familiar scaling walls, such as slowing process scaling and dies pressing against reticle and interposer limits. To expand compute, Samsung plans to evict non-compute blocks, moving their functions to the base die’s underutilized silicon.
The first target is the HBM Physical Interface (PHY), one of the largest blocks on the base die. Samsung proposes replacing the traditional interface with a much smaller die-to-die (D2D) link. On an 11 × 12.8mm HBM4 base die, the conventional PHY occupies more than 8 × 4mm, while the custom HBM D2D block is about 8.5 × 1.5mm, with channel depth cut from 5.5mm to 2mm. Because the matching interface on the XPU shrinks too, Samsung also reclaims processor silicon.
Conversely, shrinking the same power into less silicon increases power density and creates hotspots. Samsung’s answer is a Heat Path Block (HPB) that provides an alternative route for heat to exit the concentrated interface region. The company says an HPB covering more than half of the PHY can slash peak temperature by more than 35%.
The bigger Phase 1 change is moving the memory controller from the XPU to the custom HBM base die. Han estimated controllers account for 5 to 10% of an XPU's area — space that, refilled with compute, could yield a 10–20% performance gain. Moving the controller next to memory also enables a new SRAM-based repair scheme in which failed C-die addresses can be redirected to SRAM on the base die, avoiding the need to sacrifice an entire spare row or column for a single defective cell.
Phase 2: Making the die a more useful smart memory subsystem
Even with the controller moved in, Samsung says a substantial portion of the base-die area remains unused. Phase 2 fills that space with more functions, first with some relatively straightforward additions. The company proposes SoC-like telemetry and reliability features, including thermal, voltage, process, and aging sensors, as well as more advanced self-test hardware.
It also wants to use the edge of the base die for direct memory expansion, arguing that capacity is becoming as important as bandwidth. Dedicated controllers and PHYs could connect a secondary tier of external memory directly to custom HBM, rather than going through conventional PCIe expansion. Han said that extra memory could be LPDDR or even HBM, offering higher bandwidth and lower latency than PCIe-based memory extension.
Last in Phase 2 is compute — right on the base die. Samsung wants to place selected processing elements (PEs) under the DRAM, offloading memory-bound work while compute-heavy operations remain on the GPU. It calls this broader 2.5D architecture advanced HBM (aHBM), citing benefits such as less traffic across the interposer and reduced latency and I/O power draw.
Phase 3: zHBM goes fully 3D, placing the processor underneath the memory
Phase 3 appears to be Samsung's most radical step, with the company halting HBM architecture optimization and rebuilding it instead. Introducing zHBM, Samsung's “ultimate solution” for maximizing bandwidth under future AI's brutal power limits.
The zHBM concept eliminates the conventional side-by-side arrangement of XPU and HBM across an interposer. Instead, the processor sits directly beneath the DRAM stack in a true 3D structure. This architecture allows Samsung to replace the large edge PHY with distributed I/Os spread across the die. Data no longer has to travel laterally across an interposer, thereby shortening the physical path and eliminating the need for conventional HBM PHY and D2D link interfaces.
Samsung says the biggest payoff is power. Its projections show zHBM cutting I/O power by around 70% compared with HBM5. In another example, Samsung models roughly 2.3X more DRAM bandwidth while reducing memory power by about 100W compared to a four-stack HBM4E system.
On the flip side, thermals are the obvious complication. Han said Samsung is targeting roughly four-high zHBM stacks, compared with the much taller 12-high or 16-high configurations possible with conventional HBM, specifically because of heat. Distributed I/O helps by spreading the circuitry rather than concentrating it into hotspots, but zHBM is a balancing act involving capacity, bandwidth, heat, and physical integration.
Manufacturing zHBM will also require advanced wafer-on-wafer bonding and hybrid copper bonding to meet the required I/O density, with a much tighter co-design process between the DRAM and SoC teams. Samsung did not provide a firm launch date or timeline for the phases. However, HBM4’s 4nm logic base die is the concrete starting point, while cHBM and aHBM are nearer-term extensions, with zHBM as the long-term endpoint.

articles.title: OpenAI says its ad business has already hit $1B in annualized revenue - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
OpenAI says its ad business has already hit $1B in annualized revenue
OpenAI Group PBC today sought to justify its controversial decision to start running ads in ChatGPT several months ago, saying its new advertising business has now crossed the $1 billion annualized revenue run rate mark.
In a blog post, OpenAI said the milestone underlines its success in creating a “diversified business model” that gives people more choice about how to access its products, alongside its consumer subscriptions, enterprise offerings and its application programming interfaces.
The announcement comes at a time when OpenAI is facing increased pressure to justify an $852 billion valuation ahead of what’s expected to be a massive initial public offering that could launch later this year. But the new ad business, which launched around 200 days ago, is still responsible for only a small part of the company’s total revenue.
Last month, it was reported that the company generated $6.7 billion in second quarter sales, up 18% from the first quarter. Those numbers were viewed as disappointing, as just a day earlier OpenAI’s rival Anthropic PBC reported that its own revenue had grown more than 50%, to $11.6 billion, over the same period, also posting a small profit. OpenAI, in contrast, saw its operating loss grow to $12.3 billion.
Still, OpenAI tried to give prospective investors reason to be optimistic that the ad business can help it turn things around. It said it’s aiming to accelerate growth, with a target of $2.5 billion in ad revenue by the end of the year and is tracking toward total annualized revenue exceeding $40 billion.
OpenAI started testing ads within ChatGPT in February with a small number of users in the U.S., and has scaled up the experiment rapidly since then. The decision was controversial at the time, but also not unexpected, given that the company’s challenging finances have been public knowledge for a while. Digital ads have proven to be a goldmine for technology giants like Google LLC, Meta Platforms Inc. and Amazon.com Inc. for years, but OpenAI’s decision to go down that road was criticized by Anthropic, which launched a series of Super Bowl ads ridiculing its rival.
But OpenAI has been undeterred, and in today’s announcement it revealed that it’s now expanding ads in ChatGPT to more than 40 new countries, including India and others across Europe, the Middle East and North Africa. The ads appear for ChatGPT Go subscribers and free-tier users directly within the model’s responses to questions and prompts. Those users make up the vast majority of its 1 billion active weekly users.
The company said it has established ad partnerships with more than 50 brands via agencies such as Omnicom and WPP, and it made an effort to entice even more to consider using ChatGPT for outreach. In its blog post, it related a couple of success stories, saying that one e-commerce brand was able to achieve a three-fold return on its ad spending across multiple campaigns in just 28 days. Another technology partner reported that more than 80% of its ChatGPT traffic came from new customers.
The company reiterated once more that its ads are all clearly labeled and do not have any influence on ChatGPT’s outputs. Advertisers do not have access to user’s private conversations with ChatGPT.
Besides bringing ads to more markets, OpenAI said it’s going to experiment with new ad formats, buying options and measurement capabilities, so that businesses will be able to interact with consumers in more “native ways” within ChatGPT.

articles.title: Poignées de portes bloquées : Tesla lance le plus grand rappel de son histoire
articles.text:
C’est ce que l’on appelle l’effet boule de neige : suite à un accident mortel survenu en Chine en 2025, neuf constructeurs ont lancé une campagne de rappel massive concernant au total près de 4,3 millions de modèles. Tesla a tiré le gros lot, en étant la marque la plus touchée, avec 2,98 millions de voitures à inspecter de près. La totalité des Model 3 sont impliquées ainsi que les Model Y sortant de la Gigafactory de Shanghai.
Et ce n’est pas tout : l’ensemble des Model 3, Model S et Model X importés en Chine n’échappe pas au rappel. Quelle est donc la cause de ce tohu-bohu ? Une simple poignée de porte rétractable devenue la bête noire de la Chine. L’histoire remonte à octobre 2025, où une Xiaomi SU7 a pris feu suite à un accident. Le circuit d’alimentation électrique de l’auto, qui n’a pas tenu le choc, s’est coupé.
Des poignées de portes affleurantes bientôt interdites sur le plus grand marché mondial
Le problème, c’est que le dispositif d’ouverture des portes s’est également bloqué, ce qui a piégé le conducteur. Les poignées de portes étant également inopérantes de l’extérieur, il était impossible de secourir l’unique occupant du véhicule, qui a péri dans l’incendie. Le gouvernement chinois n’est pas resté insensible à l’affaire et a tout simplement interdit les poignées affleurantes sur son marché d’ici l’année prochaine.
Quatre mois seulement pour tout changer, c’est court. Et ça l’est encore plus quand cela concerne le plus grand marché automobile au monde avec des millions de véhicules en circulation. Puisqu’il est techniquement impossible de remplacer dans l’immédiat les poignées affleurantes par des modèles plus traditionnels, des mesures alternatives seront prises pour minimiser les risques sur les voitures déjà vendues.
Mises à jour logicielles et secours d’urgence : les solutions palliatives des constructeurs
Des mises à jour logicielles s’imposeront par exemple pour permettre la descente automatique des vitres afin de s’extraire par la fenêtre en cas d’accident. D’autres changements, plus mesurés, impliqueront l’ajout d’indications montrant clairement comment utiliser l’ouverture manuelle en urgence. Si tout le monde est en effet logé à la même enseigne pour les poignées extérieures, c’est une tout autre histoire concernant l’habitacle.
Certaines marques placent en effet leurs manettes de secours sur les accoudoirs quand d’autres les dissimulent au fond des vide-poches. Autant dire que niveau intuitivité, c’est le jour et la nuit ! Outre Tesla et Xiaomi, c’est aussi Leapmotor, Xpeng, Zeekr, BAIC, Dongfeng, Chery et Hongqi qui procèderont donc à des rappels d’ampleur. Même si l’Europe n’a pas encore ordonné de tels changements, les modèles précités pourront débarquer chez nous avec les modifications attendues en Chine.

articles.title: Jusqu'à 40 degrés ce week-end dans certaines régions, la rentrée s'annonce brûlante
articles.text:
Jusqu'à 40 degrés ce week-end dans certaines régions, la rentrée s'annonce brûlante
L'été n'est pas encore terminé et après des températures en baisse cette semaine, elles remonteront partout en France. Et le pic est justement attendu ce week-end puisque Météo-France annonce plus de 30 degrés sur la moitié nord et jusqu'à 35 dans le sud. On parle même de 39 degrés, voire 40 par endroits entre l'Aquitaine et l'Occitanie.
Toutefois, écartons de suite le mot "canicule". Adrien Warnan, prévisionniste chez Météo-France, écarte aussi l'étiquette de "vague de chaleur" dans les colonnes de Ouest-France. "On ne peut pas à ce stade parler de vague de chaleur mais ce qui est sûr, c'est que les températures vont remonter au fur et à mesure de la semaine, jusqu'à atteindre un pic ce week-end", explique le prévisionniste Adrien Warnan.
Jusqu'à 40 degrés possibles le samedi 5 septembre
Puisque les nuits se rallongent en cette période de l'année, le thermomètre redescend davantage entre deux journées chaudes. Pour que l'on parle de vague de chaleur, il faut que la température moyenne nationale soit au-dessus de certains seuils pendant plusieurs jours.
Et cela ne veut pas dire que la situation est bonne, bien au contraire. L'écart avec les moyennes de saison atteint des sommets. "On pourrait être 10 °C au-dessus des normales de saison dans le Sud. Dans le Nord, ce sera probablement un peu moins, même s'il fera quand même chaud pour un mois de septembre", précise Adrien Warnan. D'habitude, un mois de septembre normal dans le Midi est à 25 degrés.
Mais alors, d'où vient cette hausse soudaine ? L'origine se situe au sud des Pyrénées. Le mercredi 2 septembre, une dorsale de l'anticyclone des Açores s'étendra sur le pays avant de filer vers l'Europe centrale. L'air subtropical remontera depuis la péninsule ibérique et bloquera les perturbations atlantiques.
Le samedi 5 septembre, le modèle européen ECMWF parle du pic de l'épisode. Une vaste zone comprise entre 35 et 38 degrés pourrait s'étendre du sud-ouest au centre du pays. On parle même de pointes proches de 40 degrés selon certains scénarios entre l'Aquitaine et l'Occitanie.
Toutefois, la fiabilité de ces prévisions varie fortement selon les jours. "La fiabilité est plutôt bonne sur les régions du Sud d'ici vendredi 4 septembre et samedi 5 septembre. À partir du dimanche 6 septembre, l'incertitude grandit", indique le prévisionniste de Météo-France.
Un scénario chaud à 60 % pour le trimestre à venir
Ensuite, les scénarios divergent. Ce pourrait être un simple souffle d'air chaud de deux jours ou une installation plus durable. Le vendredi 4 septembre, le thermomètre affichera déjà 30 à 34 degrés sur une grande partie de la moitié sud. Et le dimanche 6 septembre, les valeurs les plus extrêmes pourraient reculer vers la Méditerranée et le sud-ouest. Malheureusement, la pluie manquera à l'appel.
Après une semaine d'orages, les averses se raréfient dès ce mardi. "Il y aura quelques gouttes possibles près des côtes de la Manche durant la semaine, mais ce sera plutôt des petites pluies pas vraiment conséquentes. Mais le reste du pays, ce sera plutôt des conditions anticycloniques, donc très ensoleillées et donc avec la chaleur un peu remarquable pour un début septembre", détaille Adrien Warnan. Le reste de la France passe sous des conditions anticycloniques et le soleil brillera du matin au soir.
L'été 2026 fut hors norme avec trois canicules, une sécheresse persistante et des incendies très violents. Le pays a enchaîné près de 70 jours de suite au-dessus des normales de saison. Les sols, durcis par des mois de sécheresse, encaissent très mal les pluies orageuses de ces derniers jours. L'eau ruisselle sans s'infiltrer et le risque d'inondation augmente lors des épisodes méditerranéens de l'automne.
Les agriculteurs surveillent donc les prochaines semaines avec inquiétude, alors que les nappes phréatiques n'ont pas profité des derniers orages et pour cause, ces pluies violentes repartent en surface au lieu de s'infiltrer. Météo-France retient le scénario chaud pour le trimestre à venir. La probabilité atteint 60 % contre 20 % pour un temps plus frais.

articles.title: Fable Leans Hard on "Limitless" Life Sim and RPG Gameplay
articles.text:
Monday, August 31st 2026
	
									
	
	
	
Fable Leans Hard on "Limitless" Life Sim and RPG Gameplay
The upcoming release of the Fable reboot has generated quite a bit of hype, with the studio behind the game recently revealing some impressively forgiving minimum hardware requirements for PC gamers. Following that reveal, Polygon published an interview with Xbox about Fable and its content, wherein it was revealed that Fable's actual main campaign would be on the shorter side, especially compared to most modern RPGs.
Will Kennedy, Fable Associate Director, Playground GamesWe have around 15-20 hours of mainline quest gameplay, we have around 15-20 of side and open-world exploration content gameplay. And then, of course, the life systems are limitless, so you can play them for as long as you want.
Craig Littler, another Playground Games Associate Game Director, in response to a comment that Fable is "not a huge game," added that "you can literally play it forever if that's what you want to do," reiterating that the game will rely on the life simulation elements for player retention instead of forcing players to engage in a long main quest. 
		
		Source:
				Polygon			
	
	
	
		
	
		
Will Kennedy, Fable Associate Director, Playground GamesWe have around 15-20 hours of mainline quest gameplay, we have around 15-20 of side and open-world exploration content gameplay. And then, of course, the life systems are limitless, so you can play them for as long as you want.
That's not necessarily to say that Fable won't eventually have more side quests for players to engage in for more guided and structured gameplay. However, even in its other marketing material, it's clear to see that Playground is leaning hard on Fable's life sim gameplay as a main selling point. The game's Steam page is littered with references to the life sim, exploration, and "choices matter" gameplay, and even the recent quest preview we saw at Gamescom opened with comments about its wealth of NPCs, how players can interact with them, and how they would affect the player's RPG choices and freedom.
7 Comments on Fable Leans Hard on "Limitless" Life Sim and RPG Gameplay
My hope is that they don't water it down like the 3rd game did.
Limitless life sim... yeah sure. Please, please don't reveal to us we're going to be watering plants and decorating the house... to me this just feels like they want to press the Valheim / the Sims button a little bit which the game clearly is neither of.
Game had better not be more expensive than $40,- I guess. I hope those 30-40 hours are quality, but not holding my breath here.

articles.title: Tim Cook was the best Apple CEO for his time — John Ternus' tenure will be defined by AI
articles.text:
Tim Cook was the best Apple CEO for his time — John Ternus' tenure will be defined by AI
From the Apple Watch to global growth and services, Cook built an Apple for the 21st century
By almost any measure, Tim Cook has been one of the best tech CEOs ever. He diversified product lines, launched new lines of business, expanded across the globe, and grew Apple's overall market value ten-fold.
Cook is the rare public tech figure who has, for the most part, survived the vagaries of a public life. Did he disappoint many when he appeared to bend the knee before the United States' divisive President? Absolutely, though if you understand Cook, and you listen to his explanations, you know why he did it and how it actually fits into his worldview. Generally, though, Cook's been on a 15-year-long winning streak that was made possible by both sticking to the strict ethos of Steve Jobs' original Apple charter and by pragmatically doing things his own way.
I once wrote that Steve "Jobs was Apple." Tim Cook made Apple. Where Steve Jobs' mercurial personality was intertwined with Apple across its products, development, and marketing, Cook's fingerprints are so absent from the company he's run that you might wonder if he has them.
Cook became a celebrity at Apple, but without the rabid hero worship Jobs would sometimes foster.
I'd argue, though, that in an era of a million rising individual influencer personalities, Cook may have been exactly the CEO Apple needed. He commanded the stage at keynotes and even engaged in some playful "acting" for short comedic product segments, but Cook has clearly never been interested in building on a cult of personality. When the opportunity to speak in his own biography arose, Cook characteristically deferred to the people who know him. As a result, his voice is largely absent from a tome purporting to tell the story of his remarkable life.
Cook built it to last
What Tim Cook has done is build an Apple for the ages. At his fifth anniversary, I wrote about how often he proved "he was about choice." It wasn't a complete departure from Steve Jobs, who diversified the iPod line, but Cook carried that idea through virtually every product category. In the iPhone, this has provided the freedom to offer not just a wide range of iPhones, but handsets at a wider range of sizes and prices, opening up the cachet-filled handset to an even bigger audience.
Cook took Steve Jobs' germ of an idea for "technology that would improve the relationship between patients and health care providers," and turned it into the Apple Watch. Over the next decade, Cook and company would lean into that ideal, continuously enhancing the wearable to turn it into a true life-enhancing fitness and health wearable. There was obvious pride in Cook's voice whenever he shared true stories of the Apple Watch detecting potential health issues and possibly saving lives.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
One of Cook's most remarkable creations is the Services business, originally built around a collection of "Plus"-named services that include Apple TV+ (now just Apple TV), Fitness+, Apple News, iCloud, and Apple Music. Services is now Apple's fastest-growing business, recently reaching over $30 billion in revenue in the last quarter.
I remember sitting in the Steve Jobs Theater audience in 2019 as Cook introduced a launch lineup that included Jason Momoa, Oprah, and Big Bird, wondering how, even with all that star power, Apple TV+ could compete with Netflix. Today, that's almost a laughable concern, as Apple TV enjoys some of the most acclaimed and widely-watched shows in streaming, including Widow's Bay and Ted Lasso. With movies like F1, Cook has even built a formidable movie studio.
It's not that I don't think Steve Jobs couldn't have built something similar. After all, it's unlikely we'd have Pixar's Toy Story franchise if it weren't for Jobs, who helped pivot the software company to filmmaking. Still, I think Jobs saw the Tech and Entertainment industries as two parallel but never intersecting lines. Cook's head was always on a swivel, and he has focused on business-strengthening diversification.
Missteps and power moves
For Apple purists, services might be a less exciting and interesting area than new product categories like the aforementioned Apple Watch, and Cook's track record in pure-play innovation has been somewhat spotty.
Cook's biggest swing, the mixed-reality Apple Vision Pro, remains one of the most impressive pieces of technology I have ever seen, but I have to wonder if Jobs would've made the same call, shipping a $3,499 headset and claiming it was for consumers. I have a strong feeling that the Vision Pro will not survive deeply into the John Ternus era.
Similarly, Apple under Cook has fumbled the AI ball, a fact that Apple has more or less admitted to us. It remains to be seen if the far more intelligent Siri AI will deliver on all the Apple AI promises and finally put it properly into an Artificial Intelligence race that has all but passed it by.
These are minor blemishes in an otherwise sterling track record, one that may ultimately be defined by the stunning transformation from a collection of Mac hardware that relied on Intel CPUs to an impressive array of Apple Silicon systems that perform well at virtually every level of demand.
If there's a natural handoff from the efforts of the outgoing CEO to the incoming one, John Ternus, it's this one. As a longtime hardware lead, Ternus has been deeply involved in all Mac innovations. The first time I spoke to him, it was about the short-lived 12-inch MacBook and all the work Apple did to move antennas and speakers and create a layered battery system. More recently, Ternus fronted the impressive MacBook Neo launch.
True continuity
Unlike Cook, who took over for a dying and idolized CEO in 2011, Ternus steps into the seat of a moving car as the deeply respected Cook scoots over to an Executive Chairman role.
15 years ago, people openly questioned Apple's ability to continue in Jobs' absence (I did not, writing, "Apple will be fine without Steve Jobs"). That concern does not exist in this transition. Ternus not only knows and understands the strategic plans laid out by Cook, but he can also still turn to his mentor at any moment for additional guidance.
As was the case when Cook took over, there won't be many changes evident in the first 12 months of Ternus' control. But a decade from now, there will be new products and services, devices sunsetted, and endless post-mortems about how well or poorly Ternus handled the Siri AI rollout.
Tim Cook was no Steve Jobs, which turned out better than fine for Apple. Similarly, Ternus is no Tim Cook. They have different temperaments and skill sets (Ternus is more of a true technologist). In the end, this next era of Apple is another exciting mystery full of anticipated unveilings like a folding iPhone and AR glasses, and surprises like Apple robots and EV cars (equal chance those don't happen), but the biggest surprise of all might, as it was with Cook, be what the company will be like under Ternus. That, and how Ternus will greet us all when he takes the stage for the next iPhone launch on September 9. Maybe, "Hey, everyone"?
